hypothesis: Measure whether context exclusion, touch-extreme cancellation, and confirmation-to-breakout room loss explain low frequency; quantify fixed-cost erosion of existing trades.
baseline: Current bb3_reversal_confirmation_indicator.pine defaults and research_bb3_jev_engine original RR1
entry_rules: Unchanged: BB20/3sigma touch, context/wick exclusions, later directional inside-band close, later strict wick break with >=3pip prior-center room; report on close and fill next contiguous open if >=3pip current signal-center room remains. Cancel on missing readiness/gap/extreme update/context/wick/opposite touch/expiry12 in Pine precedence.

exit_rules.target: Signal-close SMA20 rounded to tick; stop mirrored at actual entry

search_space: No strategy variants; existing baseline diagnosis only
cost_and_fill_model: Frozen chart OHLC; 1pip round-trip; no extra fees/slippage/swap; next contiguous open, one position/pair, gap exits at open, same-bar SL priority
position_sizing_and_currency: Equal initial R and equal pip descriptive scores; no account sizing
acceptance_gates: No strategy adoption. Exact candidate and saved-trade replay equality; aggregate closed trades must equal 1225. Cache SHA256 must match inherited data_manifest.
cross_symbol_rule: Report all seven and aggregate; no selection
